V. INSPECTION AND ACCEPTANCE The Contractor shall provide to the U.S. Government the deliverables described in the Technical Specifications (Section I) of this Statement of Work. Further, the Contractor shall properly perform SENSITIVE BUT UNCLASSIFIED 9 SBU - CONTRACTING AND ACQUISITIONS all required testing, quality assurance, and validation on each Taskprior to submission for Government review. The final inspection and acceptance of ALL deliverables shall be performed by the U.S. Government upon completion and submission of the entire scope of work (Products 1 through 4). If INL Guatemala officials identify an incomplete, non- functional, or defective deliverable, they shall immediately refrain from accepting it and notify the Contractor in writing. Upon notification, the Contractor shall correct or replace the deficient deliverable at no additional cost to the Government. If the Contractor fails t o meet the performance standards established in this SO

required for Task 3 (Production Deployment and User Acceptance Testing) and Task 4 (Knowledge Transfer). All coordination visits, deployment activities, and knowledge transfer sessions requiring physical presence shall take place at the GIO's institutional facilities in Guatemala City, Guatemala, as coordinated with the designated INL Guatemala point of contact. Remote work shall be permitted for all other tasks and activities where physical presence is not explicitly required, provided the Contractor maintains effective communication and coordination with INL Guatemala POC and the GIO throughout the period of performance. QUALITY ASSURANCE AND SURVEILLANCE PLAN (QASP) This plan provides an effective method to promote satisfactory contractor performance. The QASP provides a method for the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) to monitor Contractor performance, advise the Contractor of unsatisfactory performance, and notify the Contracting Officer of continued unsatisfactory performance. The Contractor, not the Government, is responsible for management and quality control to meet the terms of the contract.
